name: @fn-browser/native-host
description: Bun native-messaging host for fn-browser: bridges the MV3 extension to a local MCP HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:7722

scripts.build: bun build --compile src/main.ts --outfile=bin/host && chmod +x bin/host && bun build --compile src/fnbrowserd.ts --outfile=bin/fn-browserd && chmod +x bin/fn-browserd
